decision.reasoning_trace: I focused on actual backpacks from the product feed, filtering out non-bag items like towels, hats, and hammocks. My consideration set includes a mix of large-capacity tactical bags, a high-end investment piece, and a lightweight packable option. I chose the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) as the final selection because it offers an incredible balance of high capacity, durability, and a stellar 4.7-star rating with over 6,000 reviews, all at a very competitive price of $39.99.
